title: Horde training chunk set V1
purpose: Bind an ordered collection of independently authenticated HORDE_BIN_V1 chunks into one logical read-only training dataset without replacing their per-chunk generation manifests.

identity.logical_payload_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact record payload bytes concatenated in ascending chunk-index order
identity.chunk_set_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical identity document containing campaign, role, common manifest identity, and ordered chunk identities
identity.receipt_sha256: SHA-256 of the complete pretty-printed receipt bytes

ordering.required: Every index from zero through chunk_count - 1 occurs exactly once

invariants: Each chunk remains a complete, independently parseable HORDE_BIN_V1 file.
The receipt stores every original file, header, manifest, and payload SHA-256.
Input filenames do not determine order and are excluded from chunk_set_sha256.
Relative chunk paths may not escape the receipt directory.
Thread counts may differ by chunk and are never collapsed into one generation value.
No aggregate HORDE_BIN_V1 generation manifest is synthesized.
Random access maps each global record index to exactly one authenticated chunk and local index.
